title: devkb reports a call where my C++ code only declares a variable
body:
**What I did:** in C++, a function declares a vector local whose name happens to match a function in the project: `std::vector<int> compute(3);`. The project also has a function `int compute(int)`.

**What I got:** devkb says my function calls `compute`.

**What I expected:** no call: that line declares a variable. Real calls such as `n > compute(x)` or `y + compute(x)` must still count as calls.
